sources.title: CrossNow/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B brings these advances to a compact, deployment-friendly dense model: a native vision-language model that understands images and videos, with flexible thinking control, designed to carry complex, multi-step tasks through to completion with greater reliability.

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored - GitHub
sources.snippet: Official Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M (~16.8 GB) + a harvested uncensored SYSTEM pack. GitHub cannot host the weights. Download the GGUF below, or pull the Ollama tag — this repo bakes the residual so ollama run stays uncensored.
